name: Flashlights
description: The organizers' portal for a volunteer-run event: volunteers, speakers, sponsors, schedule.

DJANGO_ALLOWED_HOSTS.description: The hostnames the portal answers on, comma-separated (the app's host, then your own domain).

FERNET_KEY.description: Key for fields encrypted at rest. Generate one: python -c "from cryptography.fernet import Fernet; print(Fernet.generate_key().decode())"

EMAIL_URL.description: SMTP server, from any provider: smtp://user:password@host:port/?tls=true.

DJANGO_DEFAULT_FROM_EMAIL.description: The address the portal's email comes from, such as: Summit <noreply@example.org>

USE_OBJECT_STORAGE.description: Uploads go to an S3-compatible bucket from any provider.

AWS_S3_ENDPOINT_URL.description: The object storage endpoint, such as https://<region>.digitaloceanspaces.com or https://<account>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com

SITE_TITLE.description: The event or community name; page titles, Open Graph, email subjects.

SITE_DESCRIPTION.description: One line about the event, for link previews and the landing page.

BRAND_PRESET.description: The accent: beam, teal, copper, indigo or raspberry.

BRAND_PRIMARY.description: A custom #rrggbb accent instead of the preset.

DOCS_URL.description: Your documentation site, linked from the portal.

VOLUNTEERING_ENABLED.description: false hides the Volunteer hub (the lite profile).

SPONSORSHIP_ENABLED.description: false hides sponsors, tiers and donations.

STATS_PUBLIC.description: false takes the public stats pages off the site.
